payload.title: Amplify SSR uses localhost:3000 as the site origin: Prospectus sign-in and same-origin checks break
payload.description: request.nextUrl.origin is https://localhost:3000 on Amplify WEB_COMPUTE. Sign-in redirect_uri, redirects, runtime site origin and Origin checks (lib/curation-routes.ts, lib/prospectus-sign-in-routes.ts) all use it. Fix: PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN from trusted config via one helper (never from request headers); loopback dev fallback only when SITE_ENV is development; fail closed (503 site_origin_not_configured) otherwise; IaC sets it from the site host.
